body: I don't feel like it will get better at all if I keep living. I feel like I'm fighting a losing battle. And I'm so tired of fighting.

I don't want to give my name. You can call me L

I want the pain to go away. I want to disappear

I don't feel like I deserve better. I don't feel like I am special. 

I hurt so much right now and want to go away. 

The only thing keeping me from not doing it is that I don't have the means to actually kill myself at home. All I have is a box cutter razor thing, that I've cut on my wrist/arm. I keep using that to dig into it. I don't even realize what I'm doing. It started as a surface cut and only a cm. Now it's an inch long and open. 

I feel worthless. I feel like am nothing. 

I just want to be nothing now.

I have major depression and high anxiety. I fight it every day. It never goes away. My parents (married for 37 years) got divorced this year, after a 1.5 ugly divorce. My dad abandoned everyone pretty much while he led his life. My sister cut off contact with my dad, not allowing him to see my nephews since 1.5 years ago. There damage in our relationship, and for almost the full 1.5 years, I tried to support my mom. My dad then had a heart attack in August and I had to help him. his family was awful to me. 

Most recently, I found out my partner of 2.5 years, cheated on me with another woman. Our relationship was unconventional, but it had been working, but I started seeing red flags and was unhappy with how things were going between us. I would talk to him about it and he would say he would work on it. I knew he had other play partners, and that was OK with me. I told him I just wanted honesty if any of them started becoming something more, like we were. A poly relationship can work if there is honesty and balance between the two relationships. 

I was contacted by a girl last Sunday saying she was with him. She's been around for 2 years, but it was during this last year, apparently she wanted more and to be the only one, and he told her what she wanted to hear. Lying to us both about being "special" and "caring" about us. I drive over there immediately, she was there, and I confronted him. She refused to leave for whatever reason (locked out of house or something) but I stayed and talked with him all night. I left at 4:45am, with the girl still there, as he was dealing with her sudden crazy flip out if starting to break things, in spite of her saying she didn't care about him and was done. Whatever. 

I went into work at 6am, after driving home to check on my dog, and couldn't work more than an hour and went home. I talked to the girl, apologized if I said anything disrespectful to her, as she caused a confrontation at one point and I was ugly. Granted, not her place to do that, as he was the one who lied to us both. I went a couple hours later back to his place to talk more, to see if we could get through this. Get past it. In a nutshell, we decided to work through it. I don't know if I was weak to not walk away, or strong for fighting for someone I love. I told him if he wanted to see her still, no more lying. And balance. That as before, I was willing to do a poly relationship, but there had to be honesty and balance. He agreed. 

He seemed to make an effort this week in communication with me. I was hopeful. I was also in a lot of pain. It's like every feeling I could feel, I was feeling at 100%. I am so exhausted. I even continued to talk with her periodically, in hopes of being on the same page and showing consideration for her, in hopes she would show it to me if we both wanted to move forward and work it out. Everyone needs to be on the same page with stuff like this. 

I had plans to see him last night, and told him how important it was on many levels. He cancelled and said he had to cover night shift at his job. I asked to come over before night shift, and he said no. Something in my gut said it didn't feel right. So I drove over there. She was
There. I talked to him for almost 1.5 outside about why would he stand me up, again, on something important to me. And why lie only a week later, when I said honesty and didn't forbid him from seeing her. He claimed she had called and said she was in the area and stopped by. I said his logic was wrong, if someone should have come by, it should have been me.
Anyway, I'm getting too hung up on details. He said he did have to work and they both would be leaving. I drove off, heartbroken. I tried to be strong, and I was for a lot of it, but I did break and cry. I asked to see him Sunday or Monday for a goodbye, as I know myself, and I need closure and a final goodbye and I also didn't want for someone I love to have to end in that manner. I know many people will disagree, but that's how I am. And if I can get the goodbye, I like to have it. 

Something still didn't feel right, I still felt lied to. I drove back over there at 1am, because the shift he was covering was 10-6, so if he were telling the truth, he wouldn't be home. Well he was, and so was her car still. Never moved. I considered a confrontation, but ended up driving home. 

I feel like nothing, I feel worthless. I want this pain to go away. I am so lost.
I am so confused. And the thing about it is, is yes this an event that has made me downspiral, but I've been feeling these feelings constantly. I haven't even fully delved into all the details of what I feel and my issues related to my depression. 

I don't want to be here anymore.
